sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: R ECENT efforts to increase data throughput on legacy multigigabit systems face a number of challenges. It is no longer sufﬁcient to solely increase the speed of the ICs to achieve higher data rates. This is due to the emergence of other constraints, speciﬁcally signal impairments arising from the transmission media, such as frequency-dependent loss and crosstalk. sections.title: SYSTEM MEASUREMENTS
sections.text_preview: System-level tests were performed to demonstrate increased data throughput on legacy gigabit systems. The experimental setups include: 1) 10-Gb/s throughput using equalization and 4-PAM signaling over a 150-m MMF link and 2) 5-Gb/s equalization and NEXT cancellation on a 26-in FR4 backplane.
